newmap.title: Map settings
newmap.intro: Choose how the map of {name} is made. It is made when the world first starts; until then you can come back and change these settings.
newmap.steps.label: Steps to make the world
newmap.loading: Reading the planets this world's mods add. This can take up to a minute the first time.
newmap.loading_link: Show the map settings when they are ready
newmap.why.unreadable: This world's world.json cannot be read, so its map settings cannot be set here.
newmap.why.newer: A newer version of Foreman wrote this world, so this version cannot change its map settings.
newmap.why.archived: This world is archived. Unarchive it first to set its map settings.
newmap.why.made: This world's map is already made, so map settings can no longer change it.
newmap.why.version: Foreman cannot show map settings for game version {version}.
newmap.builtin.refused: The planet list this world's mods report could not be used, so only the game's own planets are shown. Their settings still work.
newmap.builtin.missing: The game did not report the planets of this world's mods, so only the game's own planets are shown. Their settings still work.
newmap.builtin.failed: The planets of this world's mods could not be read, so only the game's own planets are shown. Their settings still work. Check the world's mods, or try again later.
newmap.done: Saved the map settings of {name}. The map is made from them when the world first starts.
newmap.error.running: This world's server is starting or running, and its first start makes the map. Stop the server before changing the map settings.
newmap.error.busy: Another operation is working on this world. Try again when it has finished.
newmap.error.exchange_other_line: This string was made by Factorio {version}, but this world uses {game}. A string works only with a game version of the same series (1.1, 2.0 or 2.1). Change the world's game version on its page, or paste another string.
newmap.exchange.summary: Fill from a map exchange string
newmap.exchange.hint: Export it from Factorio's map generator and paste it here. It starts with >>> and ends with <<<. Its settings replace the ones below, which you can still change.

newmap.gone.text.one: The saved settings name this control, which the world's mods no longer add. Saving leaves it out.
newmap.gone.text.other: The saved settings name these {count} controls, which the world's mods no longer add. Saving leaves them out.

newmap.error.builtin: The planets of this world's mods could not be read, so saving now would drop the settings of their planets. Nothing was saved. Try again, or check the world's mods.
newmap.link.server: Go to the Server page to stop it
newmap.modsettings.title: Mod settings
newmap.modsettings.intro: Set the startup settings of the mods of {name}. Some change the map, such as which planets there are, so they come before the map settings.
newmap.modsettings.skipped: No mod has startup settings, so step 3 was skipped.
